## WSFS Bank and Bryn Mawr Trust Introduce Five Signature Banking Offices to Provide Clients with Holistic Financial Solutions and Advice


10/15/2026


Download (opens in new window)


WILMINGTON, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), today introduced five Signature Banking Offices, a new branch concept created alongside WSFS Bank and the company’s wealth management division, Bryn Mawr Trust, to help clients plan, borrow, save, and manage their wealth at one convenient banking office.


Signature Banking Offices are a new kind of branch experience built to support clients and their financial goals.


Signature Banking Offices are a new kind of branch experience built to support clients and their financial goals. By bringing together the superior service WSFS Bank clients rely on, and the wealth management expertise of Bryn Mawr Trust, these locations will empower clients with trusted financial advice and a full spectrum of banking and wealth management solutions. The first Signature Banking Offices will open in Greenville, Delaware; and in Ardmore, Bryn Mawr, and Narberth, Pennsylvania; and in Medford Lakes, New Jersey.


“At WSFS Bank and Bryn Mawr Trust, we believe that great financial outcomes start with great relationships,” said Jamie Hopkins, Executive Vice President and Chief Wealth Officer, WSFS and Bryn Mawr Trust. “By bringing our teams together under one roof, we’re giving our Associates the tools, expertise, and collaborative support they need to deliver truly holistic solutions to our clients.”


“We’ve seen firsthand how our branch network is the heartbeat for our clients, our Associates, and the communities where we live and work,” said Shari Kruzinski, Executive Vice President and Chief Consumer Banking Officer, WSFS Bank. “Today’s announcement further underscores our strategy to continue investing in our branch network, alongside our other core banking channels, to effectively meet the needs of our clients in an evolving financial landscape.”


WSFS Bank currently has 87 branches across the Greater Philadelphia and Delaware region. In addition, the company services clients through nearly 490 ATMs as well as through online and mobile banking platforms. To learn more, visit WSFSBank.com.


**About WSFS Financial Corporation**


WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company. Its primary subsidiary, WSFS Bank, is the oldest and largest locally headquartered bank and wealth management franchise in the Greater Philadelphia and Delaware region. As of June 30, 2026, WSFS Financial Corporation had $22.7 billion in assets on its balance sheet and $101.7 billion in assets under management and administration. WSFS operates from 114 offices, 87 of which are banking offices, located in Pennsylvania (58), Delaware (38), New Jersey (14), Florida (2), Nevada (1) and Virginia (1) and provides comprehensive financial services including commercial banking, consumer banking, treasury management, and trust and wealth management. Other subsidiaries or divisions include Arrow Land Transfer, Bryn Mawr Trust Advisors, LLC, Bryn Mawr Trust®, The Bryn Mawr Trust Company of Delaware, Cash Connect®, NewLane Finance®, WSFS Wealth® Management, LLC, WSFS Institutional Services®, and WSFS Mortgage®. Serving the Greater Delaware Valley since 1832, WSFS Bank is one of the ten oldest banks in the United States continuously operating under the same name. For more information, please visit[www.wsfsbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.wsfsbank.com&esheet=54622330&newsitemid=20261015559953&lan=en-US&anchor=www.wsfsbank.com&index=1&md5=4885a0b5ed53e7df2ddab5f3f18963ea) .
